title: GER Run Manifest
description: Complete run manifest recording the full GER execution trace. Terminal state vocabulary only; transition logic implemented by Quality Gate (future phase).

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this GER run

attempt_number.description: Attempt number within this run (1 = initial generation, 2+ = refinements)

evaluation_trace.description: Chronological trace of evaluation results for each attempt

items.description: Evaluation result summary for trace purposes
Refinement result summary for trace purposes

terminal_state.description: Terminal state of the GER run. Vocabulary only; transition logic owned by Quality Gate.
ACCEPT = all criteria passed; REJECT = unrepairable failure after max retries; ESCALATE = requires human decision

started_at.description: UTC timestamp when the GER run started

completed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the GER run completed (terminal state reached)
